definitions.explanation: The process of roasting raw materials by applying dry heat, most commonly associated with coffee beans but also applicable to tea leaves and other foods. A key step that develops flavor and aroma.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{深|ふか}{煎|い}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{焙煎|ばいせん}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
{自家焙煎|じかばいせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: An in-house roasting coffee shop opened in my neighborhood.

examples.japanese: {焙煎|ばいせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{度合|どあ}い→度合い：12456_doai⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧や⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The taste and aroma of coffee change significantly depending on the degree of roasting.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly associated with coffee. The word has become widely known in Japan with the growth of specialty coffee culture. Can be used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焙煎|ばいせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to roast)
- {自家焙煎|じかばいせん} (in-house roasting)
- {焙煎|ばいせん}⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ / {焙煎|ばいせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{度合|どあ}い→度合い：12456_doai⟧ (degree of roasting)
- {浅煎|あさい}り (light roast)
- {中煎|ちゅうい}り (medium roast)
- {深煎|ふかい}り (dark roast)
- ⟦{焙煎機|ばいせんき}→焙煎機：26214_baisenki⟧ (roasting machine, roaster)

FORMS:
{焙|ばい} (to roast, to parch) + {煎|せん} (to decoct, to roast).
